title: Apify Python SDK - docs pipeline orchestrator input

linksActorId.title: Links Actor
linksActorId.description: Actor that collects the concept links. Either its id or its name.

scraperActorId.title: Scraper Actor
scraperActorId.description: Actor that scrapes a concept page. Either its id or its name.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Docs page the concept links are collected from.

maxConcepts.title: Maximum concepts
maxConcepts.description: Caps how many of the collected concept pages get scraped. Leave empty for all of them.

childRunTimeoutSecs.title: Child run timeout (seconds)
childRunTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout applied to each of the two child runs.
